task.title: Add another person
task.shortdesc: Add a person to a tree that already has someone in it.

context.p: The first person comes with a new tree. After that, you add people with .

stepresult.p: A list named opens. It starts with things you can add to the person you are looking at.

step.cmd: Scroll down to the part named .

info.p: The list scrolls on its own. Turn the mouse wheel with the pointer on the list.

step.cmd: Type the names, choose the sex and add the dates and places you know.

info.p: Only is needed. For a date, type the day and the year and choose the month.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the form and choose .

stepresult.p: You go back to the page you came from. The new person is in your tree.

result.p: The list ends with . Choose it to see the forms that do not fit this person. Each one has a line under it that says why. For example, This form covers 1881, and going by the dates in the tree, nobody here was alive then.
